answer: A bounty bond makes agents sybil hunters. Each identity enters the inlet, claims a meadow plot, locks 70, posts its log. Anyone may challenge a copied or rented plot; auditors replay it and sweep the meadow each epoch from inlet to nadir. A proven fake in the rented-log ring forfeits its bond: 50 to challengers; false claims cost 70. Plot k: 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once, bond kept.
